description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph, which automatically inserts paragraph tags into HTML content based on double-spacing, handling text and element tokens to ensure proper paragraph structure.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph
classes.description: A class that automatically inserts paragraph tags into HTML content based on double-spacing, extending HTMLPurifier_Injector.
